## Loading rule

Discoverable does not mean loaded, active or authorized.

Use the semantic map/graph to discover the full public capability space. Load the current canonical contract when a mechanism becomes relevant. Do not infer authority from capability or access.

If normal repository navigation works, prefer the current repository files. Use these absolute raw URLs as an access fallback.
